## Problem Statement

Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe. (e.g. "It is difficult to view course relationships because...")

## Proposed Solution

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

## Project Scope

Select the modules that this feature affects:
- [ ] devorbit-api (Backend API, services, controllers)
- [ ] devorbit-web (React UI components, router, hooks)
- [ ] devorbit-mobile (Kotlin App UI, viewmodels)
- [ ] Database Schema (SQL triggers, RLS policies, tables)

## Breaking Changes

Will this feature introduce any breaking changes to existing APIs or configurations?
- [ ] No
- [ ] Yes (please detail what will break and how it should be handled)
